text: {"memo": "Adobe reported FY2024 results on March 12, 2025, covering the year ended December 28, 2024. Revenue was $24.9 billion, up 9% from $22.95 billion in FY2023 and up sharply from $14.6 billion in FY2022. GAAP diluted EPS was $3.65, while non-GAAP diluted EPS was $5.39. Net income was about $3.8 billion. Operating margin was roughly 32%, with operating income near $8 billion. Free cash flow was strong, around $8 billion. Growth continued but decelerated from double-digit revenue growth in FY2022 and FY2023. In FY2023, revenue was $22.95 billion, up 19% year over year, with GAAP EPS of $6.56 and non-GAAP EPS of $7.16; net income was $4.98 billion and operating margin about 31%. FY2022 revenue was $14.6 billion, up 19%, GAAP EPS $10.85, net income $5.8 billion, operating margin about 32%. Cash flow remained robust, though margins normalized after two years of exceptional growth. The business is transitioning away from declining Creative revenue and toward AI-driven SaaS and services, but execution risks remain. View: ADBE shares look rangebound to slightly undervalued ahead of AI monetization clarity."}
